short.q: Write a short text of five sentences saying what you eat for each meal, in Chinese with pinyin.
short.answer: 我早饭吃饼,喝茶。我午饭吃米饭和鸡肉。我晚饭吃米饭和菠菜。我喜欢水果。 wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng, hē chá. wǒ wǔfàn chī mǐfàn hé jīròu. wǒ wǎnfàn chī mǐfàn hé bōcài. wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ.
short.working: 1 mark for each sentence with correct verbs and pinyin.

short.q: Say where the tone mark goes in these syllables: hǎo and liù.
short.answer: hǎo: on a. liù: on u (the second of iu).
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 冰箱 and 用.
short.answer: 冰箱: bīngxiāng, fridge. 用: yòng, to use.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write a short paragraph in Chinese with pinyin that says there are four people in your family and names three of them.
short.answer: 我家有四口人。这是我爸爸,这是我妈妈,这是我。 wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén. zhè shì wǒ bàba, zhè shì wǒ māma, zhè shì wǒ.
short.working: 1 mark for the family size sentence, 2 marks for three correct sentences, 1 mark for pinyin, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong."
short.answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Punctuate the sentences: 你好 (greeting), 我叫小明 (statement), 你呢 (question). Write the full sentences.
short.answer: 你好! 我叫小明。 你呢?
short.working: 1 mark for the two correct marks, 2 marks for all three.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 蛋糕 and 椅子.
short.answer: 蛋糕: dàngāo, cake. 椅子: yǐzi, chair.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the Chinese words for head, hand and foot, with pinyin.
short.answer: 头 tóu, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write two strategies for speaking Chinese clearly.
short.answer: Listen first and copy the tone with your hand; say it slowly then faster; record yourself and compare.
short.working: 1 mark for each strategy, 1 mark for explaining how it helps.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Who is this?"
short.answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 周, 米饭 and 下面.
short.answer: 周: zhōu, week (short form). 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice. 下面: xiàmiàn, below.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Give the Chinese for mosque and church with pinyin.
short.answer: 清真寺 qīngzhēnsì and 教堂 jiàotáng.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin.
short.answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wòshì lǐ yǒu chuáng.
short.answer: There is a bed in the bedroom.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the difference between a statement and a question when reading aloud, with an example.
short.answer: A statement ends a little lower, like 电视在客厅。 A question ends a little higher, like 电视在哪儿? Every syllable keeps its tone.
short.working: 1 mark for each and 1 mark for keeping the tones.

short.q: Write a sentence about what you do on Monday and one about what you do on Sunday, with pinyin.
short.answer: For example 我星期一去学校。 wǒ xīngqīyī qù xuéxiào. 我星期天去教堂。 wǒ xīngqītiān qù jiàotáng. (Any correct sentences.)
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie!
short.answer: Thank you!
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "And you?"
short.answer: 你呢? nǐ ne?
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!"
short.answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
short.working: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 房间 and 摸.
short.answer: 房间: fángjiān, room. 摸: mō, to touch.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin.
short.answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
short.working: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The fridge is in the kitchen."
short.answer: 冰箱在厨房。 bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng.
short.answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
short.working: 1 mark for each meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 学校 and 厕所.
short.answer: 学校: xuéxiào, school. 厕所: cèsuǒ, toilet.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 嘴巴, 去 and 老师.
short.answer: 嘴巴: zuǐba, mouth. 去: qù, to go. 老师: lǎoshī, teacher.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the five weather words in pinyin.
short.answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
short.working: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I use my ears to hear."
short.answer: 我用耳朵听。 wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 菠菜 and 星期一.
short.answer: 菠菜: bōcài, spinach. 星期一: xīngqīyī, Monday.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Rearrange and translate: 浴室 / 花园 / 旁边 / 在.
short.answer: 浴室在花园旁边。 The bathroom is beside the garden.
short.working: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for the meaning.

short.q: Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My birthday is on 5 March."
short.answer: 我的生日是三月五号。 wǒ de shēngrì shì sān yuè wǔ hào.
short.working: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

short.q: Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.
short.answer: On Wednesday I go to school.
short.working: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 同学们 and 二.
short.answer: 同学们: tóngxuémen, classmates. 二: èr, two.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

short.q: Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters.
short.answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
short.working: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

short.q: Write in characters the days Friday, Saturday and Sunday.
short.answer: 星期五, 星期六, 星期天.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups.
short.answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
short.working: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.

short.q: Explain why tones are important in Mandarin. Give one example with meanings.
short.answer: The tone changes the meaning of a word. For example mā means mother but mǎ means horse.
short.working: 1 mark for saying tone changes meaning, 2 marks for a correct pair with meanings.

short.q: Add punctuation to: 我喜欢芒果香蕉葡萄你呢
short.answer: 我喜欢芒果、香蕉、葡萄。你呢?
short.working: 1 mark for 、, 1 mark for 。, 1 mark for ?.

short.q: Explain what tone, volume and vocal projection mean when reading aloud.
short.answer: Tone is the rise and fall of each syllable, volume is how loud you speak and projection is sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting.
short.working: 1 mark for each.

short.q: Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 雪, 葡萄 and 今天.
short.answer: 雪: xuě, snow. 葡萄: pútao, grapes. 今天: jīntiān, today.
short.working: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.
